race.description: Benstud Standardbreds 0 To 2 Win Trotters Hcp
race.comment: LOCHINVAR SON (4) is the clear danger if he leaves last week's beaten-a-long-way tenth behind; his previous second to Moreep keeps him firmly in calculations. BLACK VIPER (6) brings the stronger longer-term Albion Park 2138m profile, though his recent efforts demand some trust. PROPELLED PRINCESS (1) has not been sharp enough to win on recent margins, but the front mark and a recent result over LOCHINVAR SON give her a place pathway. SMOKEY BEAR (2) looks the best of the remaining two.
